network_status.network: Annuario dei dati ambientali - evento Vaia in Friuli Venezia Giulia
network_status.summary_it: La fonte ISPRA documenta l'esondazione del Degano e il collasso del ponte di Comeglians, ma non riporta una misura idrometrica locale. I livelli pubblicati per il Tagliamento a Venzone non sono trasferibili all'alto Degano.
network_status.summary_en: The ISPRA source documents Degano flooding and the Comeglians bridge collapse but reports no local hydrometric measurement. Published Tagliamento levels at Venzone cannot be transferred to the upper Degano.

provenance.method: Manual extraction encoded in the ARCUS event-report curation registry

caveats: The cited source review is complete; no compatible tabulated bridge-section value is assigned.
ARCUS does not digitise plotted hydrographs into false-precision event peaks.
The encoded failure process remains separate from hydrometric evidence.
Rainfall is not converted into stage or discharge.
